title: armor stand owner
description: This project adds the ability to protect your Armor Stand. Using this datapack will prevent others from destroying your Armor Stand.
body:
1. This data pack will prevent others from destroying your armor stand. 
2. Due to technical limitations, you must use a mod or plugin that prevents the Armor Stand from removing its armor.
3. Warning: Apply to a server with only 1 player online, otherwise others will be able to destroy your armor stand.
4. IMPORTANT: To destroy an armor stand you've placed, press crouch while within 1 block of the armor stand.
